---
title: quarto-graph
type: moc
---

`quarto-graph` enables using **Wikilinks** in a quarto website, where pages are
connected via links. Wikilinks can expediate knowledge discovery, because 
connections can be explicitly visualized in a graph. This site itself was built
with `quarto-graph`.

`quarto-graph` doesn't rewrite your `.qmd` files, generate pages, or replace
Quarto's own project structure — it only resolves links and draws a graph
at render time. See [[Limitations]] for what it doesn't do yet.

Click on a node, which is a link to a specific page of this website.

{{< quarto-graph-full >}}

Connections, the *edges* that connect each *node* in a graph, are automatically 
determined by a few simple rules:

- All pages are *nodes*
- Connections between are explicitly determined using double square brackets e.g.

`[[Getting Started]]`

Where the inside text, can be an alias that you give a particular page. Which is
specified in the page's frontmatter.

Or you can use a regular markdown link

[`[Getting Started](getting-started/index.qmd)`](getting-started/index.qmd)


In addition to the graph widget shown above, wikilinks allow us to auto-generate 
[[Backlinks]], scroll to the end of this page to see all the pages that 
reference the current page.

*This project is inspired by Obisidian Graph's, but wikilinks have been a feature
and concept for a long time.*
